title: How Many Queens to BEAT Magnus?
summary: Original 'how many queens' video vs the Magnus bot. Game 1 regular (loss). Then pieces are replaced one at a time with queens until a win; ends only on checkmate (not draw). Wins with three queens total (two extra, ~18 points).
rules: After each loss replace one more White piece/pawn with a queen.
Only a checkmate win ends the challenge; draws don't count.
win_condition: Checkmate the Magnus bot (took 3 queens total).

opponent.name: Magnus bot
opponent.avatar_description: cartoon Magnus Carlsen, brown hair, big smile, grey hoodie

setup: Standard; game 3: two White pawns replaced by queens (which pawns not stated).
current_impl_issues: Impl kingplus t=Q (king + queens only) wrong; full army, pawns swapped for queens, starting even; draws must not end the challenge.
evidence: 0:22 'first game we'll just play a regular game... start replacing my pieces one by one with Queens until I finally win... ends when I actually win not when I draw'; 19:59 'it only took us three queens'.
